name: interactive-faq-accordion
title: Interactive FAQ Accordion
description: Frequently asked questions section with tidy stacked disclosures and animated chevron toggles.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Faq Disclosure Toggle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
